theme: Mutual fund literacy: what is an expense ratio, active vs passive, fund categories
headline: Understanding Expense Ratios in Mutual Funds
body: Expense ratios represent the annual cost of managing your investment. Lower ratios mean more of your money stays invested.
caption: Every fund charges fees to cover operational and management costs. These expenses are expressed as a percentage of assets managed. Active funds typically have higher ratios due to research teams, while passive funds track indices with minimal intervention. #MutualFundBasics #ExpenseRatio #InvestmentCosts #FundLiteracy #SmartInvesting
